pickthall.translator: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930), public domain

verses.text: Say: He is Allah, the One
Allah, the eternally Besought of all
He begetteth not nor was begotten
And there is none comparable unto Him

yusufali.translator: Abdullah Yusuf Ali, The Holy Quran (1934), public domain

verses.text: Say: He is Allah, the One and Only
He begetteth not, nor is He begotten
And there is none like unto Him
